source_data.desc:
_Somewhat like the cruel crossbreed of troll and gnome, the moss lurkers are a primitive race of forest and cavern dwellers with long, greenish beards and hair. Their hides are mossy green or peaty amber, and a vaguely fungal scent surrounds them at all times._  
Like their trollish relatives, moss lurkers have large and often grotesque noses. Their claws are bright red when unsheathed, and their teeth tend toward the long and snaggly. They wear simple clothes of homespun wool or leather, or go naked in the summer. Their hats are sometimes festooned with toadstools or ferns as primitive camouflage.  
**Rocks and Large Weapons.** Moss lurkers have a fondness for throwing stones onto enemies from a great height, and they often employ enormous axes, warhammers, and two-handed swords that seem much larger than such a small creature should be able to lift.
source_data.name: Moss Lurker

Someone who consumes the contaminated substance must make a successful DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour. When the poison is introduced, the moss lurker can choose a poison that also causes the victim to fall unconscious, or to become paralyzed while poisoned in this way. An unconscious creature wakes if it takes damage, or if a creature uses an action to shake it awake."}]

Like their trollish relatives, moss lurkers have large and often grotesque noses. Their claws are bright red when unsheathed, and their teeth tend toward the long and snaggly. ru.description:
Вроде как жестокий гибрид тролля и гнома, мшистые скрытники — примитивная раса лесных и пещерных обитателей с длинными, зеленоватыми бородами и волосами. Их шкуры мшисто-зелёного или торфяного янтаря, и смутно грибковый запах окружает их во все времена.

Как и их троллиные родственники, у мшистых скрытииков большие и часто гротескные носы. Их когти яркие красные, когда они вынуты из ножен, и их зубы имеют тенденцию к длинным и косым. Они носят простые одежды из самодельного шерсти или кожи, либо ходить голым летом. Их шляпы иногда украшены весёлыми поганками или папоротниками как примитивным камуфляжем.
ru.name: Мшистый скрытник
